comment: The class of each tool source of flowmark (S1), found by the layout of the repository (kit K286): ecosystem names the tool it uses, policy the reason no ecosystem tool applies.

examples/board/web/app/handlers.php.reason: the handlers of the board example, an application of the PHP server; it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/web/client/main.ts.tool: htmx.org and @polyspec/hyper-client run the page of the board example in the browser

examples/board/web/node/handlers.ts.reason: the handlers of the board example, an application of the Node server; it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/web/node/main.ts.tool: node:http through App.server of @polyspec/hyper-server serves the board example

examples/board/web/node/model/models.ts.tool: orm-gen of @polyspec/orm generates it from the corpus catalog (the commands of the board README)

examples/board/web/node/postForm.ts.tool: @polyspec/crudui-generator-html renders the post form of the board example

examples/board/web/node/posts.ts.tool: @polyspec/orm reaches the flowmark corpus of the board example through markdown://

examples/board/web/public/index.php.tool: the front controller of the PHP SAPI (the built-in server or php-fpm) calls App::run of polyspec/hyper-server

examples/board/web/src/Assets.php.reason: reads the manifest that the asset build writes (HY-76) for the layout of the board example; no ecosystem tool names the assets of this build

examples/board/web/src/Model/Comments.ph.tool: orm-gen of polyspec/orm generates it from the corpus catalog (the commands of the board README)

examples/board/web/src/Model/People.php.tool: orm-gen of polyspec/orm generates it from the corpus catalog (the commands of the board README)

examples/board/web/src/Model/Posts.php.tool: orm-gen of polyspec/orm generates it from the corpus catalog (the commands of the board README)

examples/board/web/src/Model/bootstrap.p.tool: orm-gen of polyspec/orm generates it from the corpus catalog (the commands of the board README)

examples/board/web/src/Model/schema_decl.tool: orm-gen of polyspec/orm generates it from the corpus catalog (the commands of the board README)

examples/board/web/src/Pages.php.reason: the paging of the post list of the board example, an application of the PHP server; it implements no tool of an ecosystem

examples/board/web/src/PostForm.php.tool: polyspec/crudui-generator renders the post form of the board example

examples/board/web/src/Posts.php.tool: polyspec/orm reaches the flowmark corpus of the board example through markdown://

scripts/check-refs.mts.reason: flowmark's rule that every task ID a document names resolves to an item of a checklist; no ecosystem tool reads the IDs of these checklists

scripts/go-test.mts.tool: go test runs the tests of each Go module, on macOS on the case-sensitive folder that hdiutil mounts

scripts/record-slugs.mts.tool: gh api asks GitHub's renderer, VS Code's own slugify.ts runs on markdown-it, and cargo builds gitlab-glfm-markdown, whose heading ids are recorded
